Container.Name: GitPreserver
Container.Overview: A life preserver for your git repositories. Mirror-clones all repos with full branch and tag history, exports issues/PRs/releases as JSON, and syncs encrypted backups to Backblaze B2, AWS S3, Google Drive, OneDrive, MEGA, SMB, or any rclone-supported destination. Runs on a cron schedule — no persistent daemon required.

Config.Name: Personal Access Token
Config.Description: GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket Personal Access Token. GitHub requires repo and read:user scopes.

Config.Name: Username
Config.Description: GitHub username or organization name to back up.

Config.Name: Host Type
Config.Description: Git host: github | bitbucket | gitlab | gitea

Config.Name: Backup Path
Config.Description: Host path where backup snapshots are stored.

Config.Name: rclone Remote
Config.Description: rclone remote name (e.g. b2-remote). Leave blank for local-only backup.

Config.Name: rclone Path
Config.Description: Path or bucket on the remote to sync into.

Config.Name: rclone Config
Config.Description: Host path to your rclone.conf file.

Config.Name: Enable Encryption
Config.Description: Set to true to encrypt backups via rclone crypt. Requires GITPRESERVER_CRYPT_REMOTE.

Config.Name: Crypt Remote
Config.Description: rclone crypt remote name (required if encryption is enabled).

Config.Name: Retention Days
Config.Description: Days to keep local snapshots. Set to 0 to keep forever.

Config.Name: Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression for backup schedule (default: Sundays at 2 AM).

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Log verbosity: debug | info | warn | error

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: Set to true to test without writing or syncing anything.
